item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Conway The Machine - LULU
item.description:
LULU is the Buffalo MC's first solo release since 2019's Look What I Became. Last week, he dropped "Shoot Sideways" featuring Schoolboy Q. Queens veteran Cormega drops a guest verse on "They Got Sonny."

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

LULU es el primer lanzamiento en solitario del rapero de Buffalo desde Look What I Became de 2019. La semana pasada, publicó "Shoot Sideways" con la colaboración de Schoolboy Q. El veterano rapero de Queens, Cormega, participa con un verso en "They Got Sonny".

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
